title: homing detached signature
description: Detached Ed25519 signature document: manifest.sig and index.json.sig. Signs "homing/<type>/v1" || 0x00 || exact document bytes, with type manifest, bundle or index.
$comment: The whole document is at most 4096 bytes.

key_id.description: First 16 hex characters of sha256(public key).

sig.description: Standard base64 (with padding) of the 64-byte signature.
